agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Zoom meeting: 857 9584 6193
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak or submit written comments is 4 pm on March 21, 2023.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Site Plan Control application related to Phase 3 and 4 of The Ottawa Hospital Master Plan
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Applicant for the Ottawa Hospital provided a slide presentation and answered questions from the Committee. A copy of their slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk. Jeff Fahs, Marnie Peters and Jason-Emery Groen answered questions at the committee.
Following discussion, the Committee RECEIVED the presentation.

agenda_items.title: Planning, Real Estate and Economic Development

sub_agendas_items.title: Update – Transportation Master Plan
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Jennifer Armstrong, Program Manager, Transportation Policy and Networks, Deb Lightman, Senior Project Manager, Sustainable Transportation and Zlatko Krstulic, Program Manager, Active Transportation Planning, provided an oral update and answered questions from the Committee.
A copy of their slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Following discussions, the Committee RECEIVED the presentation for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update – draft 2023 annual City of Ottawa Municipal Accessibility Plan report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Lucille Berlinguette-Saumure, Program Manager, and Megan Richards, Corporate Accessibility Specialist, of the Accessibility Office, provided an oral update.
Following discussions, the Committee RECEIVED the presentation for information.

agenda_items.title: Other Business
agenda_items.minutes:
On behalf of Rick O’Connor, City Clerk, Tyler Cox, Manager, Legislative Services, thanked members of the outgoing 2018-2022 Accessibility Advisory Committee for their service
Lucille Berlinguette- Saumure, Program Manager of the Accessibility Office thanked members for their dedication for many years.
Members of the Committee acknowledged and thanked one another and City staff for the years of commitment.
